about: Two production lines + warehouse, 2 h 06 min measured after the 10 min warm-up: the AGVs 1 of the vehicle view (design 3.1, 4.1).

insights.title: Press line broke down 2 times and was out of service 11 % of the time.
insights.detail: Over 2.1 h, machine time lost to breakdowns at Press line was 11 %. Every outage stops production there until the repair is done.
insights.suggestion: Add a second machine at Press line so production continues during a repair, or cut the mean repair time (now 7 min).

insights.title: Machining waits for input 58 % of the time.
insights.detail: Over 2.1 h, Machining was idle for lack of input loads 58 % of the time and worked 42 %.
insights.suggestion: Check the supply into Machining: its suppliers produce or deliver less often than it could work.

insights.title: Final assembly waits for input 48 % of the time.
insights.detail: Over 2.1 h, Final assembly was idle for lack of input loads 48 % of the time and worked 52 %.
insights.suggestion: Check the supply into Final assembly: its suppliers produce or deliver less often than it could work.
